_README: Symbol mismatches reviewed by a human and accepted, for scripts/check_external_ids.py.
A mismatch is accepted when the provider's symbol differs by naming convention rather
than identity: provider-side rebrands that keep the ID, and wrapper assets where the
catalogue uses a short symbol and the provider spells out the full deployment.
Each key is '<asset>:<provider>:<external_id>'. If the catalogue ever repoints that
asset at a different ID the key stops matching and the mismatch is reported again,
so an acknowledgement can never outlive the mapping it was granted for.
Keys of the form '<asset>:<provider>' instead justify a provider with no exact listing
for the asset, for scripts/check_new_assets.py. Say what was searched (contract, issuer,
chain, symbol) and why the near matches are a different asset.
